pages.title: Finding Lost Touken Danshi
pages.text: The Citadel has grown and there are more Touken Danshi, so a few may wander off without notice.$(br2)To help Saniwa find their Touken Danshi, the mod provides a location query command that lists the name, dimension, coordinates, and distance of all Touken Danshi under your name.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Enter the following in the chat box at the bottom left:$(br2)$(li)/tr locate$(br)$(li)/toukenranbu locate$(br2)Both have the same effect and are functionally identical.$(br2)A list will be displayed; green indicates within 64 blocks, white indicates same dimension but farther away, and cross-dimension entries will show the dimension name and coordinates.

pages.title: Count Only
pages.text: If you just want to know how many summoned Touken Danshi you have in total, use:$(br2)$(li)/tr count$(br)$(li)/toukenranbu count$(br2)It will only tell you the number, without listing specific locations.$(br2)Note that Touken Danshi stored in Capture Talismans are not counted, as they have been removed from the world.
